summary.en: A line in space is fixed by a point and a direction vector, a plane by a point and a normal vector — and once both are written that way, questions about intersection, distance and angle become dot and cross products.
summary.et: Sirge ruumis on määratud punkti ja sihivektoriga, tasand punkti ja normaalvektoriga — ning kui mõlemad on nii kirja pandud, taanduvad lõikumise, kauguse ja nurga küsimused skalaar- ja vektorkorrutisteks.
